warning_signs: Small dark spots appear on older leaves
Leaves gradually turn yellow and fall
Early Blight.advice: Remove severely affected leaves and avoid keeping the foliage wet for long periods.
Early Blight.treatment: Remove infected plant material and improve air circulation. Use a fungicide only when necessary and according to the product label.
Early Blight.application: Follow the locally approved product label for crop, dose, spray interval, and pre-harvest interval.
Early Blight.safety_note: Use only products approved for tomato and the diagnosed disease. Follow the label and use appropriate protective equipment.

warning_signs: Dark water-soaked patches appear on leaves
Brown or black lesions may spread quickly
Fruit may develop dark firm patches
Late Blight.advice: Remove affected plant material and improve air circulation around plants.
Late Blight.treatment: Remove severely affected material and use an appropriately approved fungicide when required.
Late Blight.application: Follow the locally approved product label for dose, spray interval, and pre-harvest interval.
Late Blight.safety_note: Use only products approved for tomato and late blight. Follow the label and wear appropriate protective equipment.

warning_signs: Small water-soaked spots appear on leaves
Bacterial Leaf Spot.advice: Remove heavily affected leaves and avoid overhead irrigation.
Bacterial Leaf Spot.treatment: Remove affected plant material and reduce leaf wetness. Use only locally approved disease-management products when necessary.
Bacterial Leaf Spot.application: Follow the locally approved product label for chilli, including dose and application interval.
Bacterial Leaf Spot.safety_note: Use only products approved for chilli and the diagnosed disease. Follow the product label.

warning_signs: Small brown spots appear on leaves
Spots may have a yellow halo
Early Leaf Spot.advice: Monitor lower leaves regularly and remove heavily affected plant material.
Early Leaf Spot.treatment: Use integrated disease management and an approved fungicide when necessary.
Early Leaf Spot.application: Follow the locally approved product label for groundnut, including dose and spray interval.
Early Leaf Spot.safety_note: Use only products approved for groundnut and the diagnosed disease.

warning_signs: Severe infection can affect the panicle
Rice Blast.advice: Monitor fields regularly and follow locally approved crop-management recommendations.
Rice Blast.treatment: Use integrated disease management and an approved blast-management fungicide when necessary.
Rice Blast.application: Follow the locally approved product label for rice, including dose, application timing, and pre-harvest interval.
Rice Blast.safety_note: Use only products approved for rice blast in your region and follow the product label.
